name: Dow Corning DOWSIL 789 Silicone Weatherproofing Sealant (280ml)
shortDescription: One-part neutral cure architectural silicone sealant with ±50% joint movement capacity, offering unprimed primerless adhesion to glass, aluminium, and granite facades.
overview: DOWSIL 789 Silicone Weatherproofing Sealant (formerly Dow Corning 789) is an internationally specified architectural grade neutral-cure silicone sealant engineered for general weather sealing in curtain walls and building facades. Formulated specifically to accommodate building movement and withstand extreme outdoor atmospheric exposure, it cures upon atmospheric moisture exposure to form a resilient, flexible silicone elastomer with ±50% joint movement capability. It exhibits tenacious unprimed primerless adhesion to painted/anodized aluminium, glass, granite, marble, steel, and masonry.
keyFeatures: Neutral alkoxy cure system: non-corrosive to metals, galvanized steel, and masonry
Exceptional movement capability of ±50% accommodates heavy thermal expansion joints
Outstanding unprimed adhesion to architectural aluminium, float glass, and natural stone
Immune to sunlight UV degradation, ozone, rain, snow, and extreme temperature fluctuations
Wide operational temperature service span: flexible from -50°C to +150°C
Non-slump thixotropic paste: easily applied in wide horizontal and overhead joints
Complies with international architectural standards: ASTM C920 Type S, Grade NS, Class 50
applications: Structural glazing weather-seal perimeter joints and glass curtain walls
Aluminium Composite Panel (ACP) facade panel expansion joints
Expansion joints in granite, marble, precast concrete, and brick cladding
Perimeter sealing around commercial window and door frame fenestration
